Aniimo End Game - What to Expect
In this Fextralife video, I'm gonna be talking about some of the features of Aniimo. The Next Generation free-to-play creature-catching open-world RPG. Mainly what you'll be doing in the later stage of the game or the end game once you become more familiar with the world of idyll and its many adorable Aniimo, your time in Aniimo doesn't have to end with exploration of the map and tending to your homeland, but there are also additional challenges that you and your friends can take on together with the Aniimo that you've caught.
